structure: Part 8, Templates. Read in full: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js (206 lines, 12 tests in 3 describes: 'manage templates' 2 tests, 'a saved template' 6 tests, 'create a new template' 4 tests, the first of which has 5 steps), e2e/support/journey.js (283 lines) and e2e/support/fixtures.js (48 lines, which only records each test's navigations into test-results/meta and asserts nothing). Covered: the manage templates list at /templates and the dashboard's Use template button; a saved template's view page (/templates/<slug>), its use (/use), edit (/edit), change-one-section (/change/<page>), delete confirmation (/delete), the POST-reloads and unknown-slug redirects; creating a template (notification type, /templates/create name page, origin and commodity in template mode, the documents and declaration redirects, review and save), saving with no name (/templates/save) and discarding (/templates/discard) inside and outside a template journey. Shared journey.js assertions these tests call and that are claimed here: the /design-release-2.1 mount (url, urlFor), expectHeading (first h1), expectBackLink (.govuk-back-link href), saveAndContinue (button action=continue), submitForm (named main button), answerOrigin and answerCommodity with SPECIES.cattle. The rest of journey.js belongs to other parts.

claims.statement: Every Design Release 2.1 route the templates tests visit is mounted under the /design-release-2.1 path prefix.
The manage templates page is at /templates and its page title is 'Manage templates - Import notification service - GOV.UK'.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:15-16 (manage templates › lists the saved templates with view and use actions)
claims.quote:
await page.goto(url('/templates'))
    await expect(page).toHaveTitle('Manage templates - Import notification service - GOV.UK')

claims.statement: The manage templates page's main heading is 'Manage templates'.
The manage templates page says 'Select, manage or create new notification templates'.
claims.quote: await expect(main).toContainText('Select, manage or create new notification templates')

claims.statement: The manage templates page has a 'Create new template' link to /templates/create?new=1.
claims.quote: await expect(main.locator('a', { hasText: 'Create new template' })).toHaveAttribute('href', url('/templates/create?new=1'))

claims.statement: The manage templates page has a 'My templates' heading over the list of saved templates.
The template list shows a results count, which reads 'Show 1-15 of 15 results' for the 15 saved templates the prototype starts with.
The saved templates listed include Arena Aintree, Rice Lane City Farm, Monk Park Farm, Acorn Farm and Glen Keen Farm.
claims.quote: const TEMPLATE_NAMES = ['Arena Aintree', 'Rice Lane City Farm', 'Monk Park Farm', 'Acorn Farm', 'Glen Keen Farm']
claims.note: Only 5 of the 15 template names are asserted; the other 10 are not named in the suite.

claims.statement: Each listed template has a 'View template' link to /templates/<template slug>; the first, Arena Aintree, links to /templates/arena-aintree.
claims.note: Only the first row's link is asserted; the per-row pattern is read from the slug form of the name.

claims.statement: Each listed template has a 'Use template' link to /templates/<template slug>/use; the first links to /templates/arena-aintree/use.
On the manage templates page the active service navigation item is 'Templates'.
The dashboard has a 'Use template' button that opens the manage templates page at /templates.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:30-34 (manage templates › the dashboard "Use template" button opens manage templates)
claims.quote:
await page.goto(url())
    await page.locator('main').getByRole('button', { name: 'Use template' }).click()
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/templates'))

claims.statement: Following 'View template' from the list opens the template's view page at /templates/arena-aintree, headed with the template's name, 'Arena Aintree'.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:38-42 (a saved template › view: the template answers with a change link per section)
claims.quote:
await page.locator('main a', { hasText: 'View template' }).first().click()
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/templates/arena-aintree'))
    await expectHeading(page, 'Arena Aintree')

claims.statement: The template view page shows the word 'Templates' in its main content, likely as a caption above the name.
claims.note: The test asserts only that the text appears in main; that it is a caption is inferred.

claims.statement: The template view page shows the date the template was created, as 'Date created: 15 April 2026' for Arena Aintree.
The template view page has a 'Use template' link to /templates/arena-aintree/use.
The template view page has a link with the text 'Delete' to /templates/arena-aintree/delete.
The template view page shows the template's answers with a 'Change' link per section; the first goes to /templates/arena-aintree/change/origin-of-the-import.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:48 (test title: 'the template answers with a change link per section')

claims.statement: The template view page groups its answers under numbered section headings, starting with '1. About the consignment'.
The template view page's back link goes to /templates.
Using a template (/templates/arena-aintree/use) starts a new draft notification and redirects to the notification hub at /notification-hub.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:54-56 (a saved template › use: starts a new draft notification from the template)

claims.statement: A notification started from a template shows a 'Draft' status with a live animals reference in the form 'Live animals - GBN-AG-26-<code>'.
The notification hub for a notification started from a template has the heading 'Notification tasklist'.
The suite does not prove which answers a notification started from a template carries over: it asserts only that the hub's text contains the character '2'.
claims.note: The intent of the '2' assertion (a count of completed sections, or a reference digit) is not stated. Which answers are copied from the template into the draft is unproven.

claims.statement: A template's section Change link opens the section's journey page in template review mode: the first Change link goes to /origin-of-the-import?from=template-review.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:64-67 (a saved template › change one section: save and return goes back to the template)
claims.note: The link's href is /templates/arena-aintree/change/origin-of-the-import (p8-018), so that route redirects to the journey page with from=template-review.

claims.statement: A journey page opened to change one template section shows a single action button, 'Save and return'.
A journey page opened to change one template section shows a 'Cancel' link.
claims.note: Where Cancel leads is not asserted.

claims.statement: The 'Save and return' button on a template section edit submits the action value 'continue'.
claims.note: mechanism: the test clicks button[name=action][value=continue] while the only action button reads 'Save and return' (p8-026), so that button carries value continue.

claims.statement: Saving a changed template section returns to the template's view page at /templates/arena-aintree.
After a template section is saved, the template view page shows a notification banner '<template name> has been updated', such as 'Arena Aintree has been updated'.
The template keeps the changed answer: after the internal reference is changed to AINTREE-2026 the template view page shows AINTREE-2026.
A template's origin section includes the internal reference field (#internal-reference).
A POST to a template's view page (/templates/arena-aintree) changes nothing and redirects (302) back to the same page.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:79-83 (a saved template › posting to a template page just reloads it, and an unknown template returns to the list)
claims.note: 'changes nothing' is from the test title 'just reloads it'; the test asserts only the 302 and location.

claims.statement: Opening a template that does not exist (/templates/no-such-template) redirects to the manage templates list at /templates.
Editing a template (/templates/arena-aintree/edit) opens it on its own task list at /notification-hub.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:88-90 (a saved template › edit: opens the template on its own task list)
claims.note: No link to /edit is asserted on any page; how a user reaches it is not shown.

claims.statement: A template's task list shows 'Template' followed by the template's name, such as 'Template Arena Aintree', in place of a notification status and reference.
claims.note: 'in place of a status and reference' is inferred from the Draft strip on a notification hub (p8-022).

claims.statement: A template's task list has the heading 'Template tasklist'.
A template has no documents section: its task list has no 'Upload documents' link.
A template's task list has a section headed '4. Addresses'.
A template's task list has a 'Review template' link to /review-notification.
A template's task list has a 'Return to manage templates' link to /templates.
claims.quote: await expect(main.locator('a', { hasText: 'Return to manage templates' })).toHaveAttribute('href', url('/templates'))

claims.statement: The template's Delete link opens a confirmation page at /templates/arena-aintree/delete titled 'Delete this template? - Import notification service - GOV.UK'.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:102-106 (a saved template › delete: confirm, then the list says it was deleted)
claims.quote:
await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/templates/arena-aintree/delete'))
    await expect(page).toHaveTitle('Delete this template? - Import notification service - GOV.UK')

claims.statement: The delete template confirmation page's heading is 'Delete this template?'.
The delete template confirmation page shows the template's name as 'Name' followed by the name, such as 'Name Arena Aintree'.
The delete template confirmation page says 'Confirm that you want to delete this template.'
claims.quote: await expect(main).toContainText('Confirm that you want to delete this template.')

claims.statement: The delete template confirmation page warns 'This action cannot be undone.'
claims.quote: await expect(main).toContainText('This action cannot be undone.')

claims.statement: The delete template confirmation page's back link goes to the template's view page, /templates/arena-aintree.
Pressing 'Yes, delete' on the delete template confirmation page deletes the template and returns to /templates.
After a template is deleted the manage templates page shows a notification banner '<template name> has been deleted', such as 'Arena Aintree has been deleted'.
A deleted template leaves the list: the count drops to 'Show 1-14 of 14 results'.
No cancel or 'No' option on the delete template confirmation page is asserted; only the back link and 'Yes, delete' are proven.
claims.note: Looked through the delete and discard tests; neither asserts a way to decline other than the back link.

claims.statement: Creating a new template asks the notification type first: 'Create new template' leads to /notification-type.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:124-127 (create a new template › type, name, answers, review, save)
claims.quote:
await page.locator('main a', { hasText: 'Create new template' }).click()
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/notification-type'))
claims.note: The link's href is /templates/create?new=1 (p8-005), so that route redirects to the notification type page.

claims.statement: In template creation, choosing a notification type (live-animals) and continuing goes to the template name page at /templates/create.
The template name page's title is 'Enter template name - Import notification service - GOV.UK'.
claims.quote: await expect(page).toHaveTitle('Enter template name - Import notification service - GOV.UK')

claims.statement: The template name page shows 'Create a new template'.
claims.note: Whether this is the heading or a caption is not asserted.

claims.statement: The template name page has one text field labelled 'Enter template name'.
The template name page has a 'Cancel and return to manage templates' link to /templates.
claims.quote: await expect(page.locator('main a', { hasText: 'Cancel and return to manage templates' })).toHaveAttribute('href', url('/templates'))

claims.statement: The template name page's back link goes to /notification-type.
Entering a template name and pressing 'Save and continue' goes to the first journey page, /origin-of-the-import.
claims.quote:
await page.getByLabel('Enter template name').fill('Weekly Irish cattle')
      await submitForm(page, 'Save and continue')
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/origin-of-the-import'))

claims.statement: A template is built from the same journey questions as a notification: the origin page (country of origin search, region of origin) and the commodity search are answered as in a notification.
claims.quote:
await answerOrigin(page, { search: 'Irel', country: 'Republic of Ireland' })
      await answerCommodity(page, SPECIES.cattle)
claims.note: Inferred because the test drives the template through the shared notification helpers: country 'Republic of Ireland' from the search 'Irel', region of origin 'No', species cattle-bos-taurus from the search 'cattle'.

claims.statement: After the commodity page in a template journey, continuing returns to the template's task list at /notification-hub rather than to the next question.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:145-148 (step 'origin and commodity, after which the template returns to its task list')
claims.note: Which page follows origin in template mode is not asserted, only that the commodity page's continue ends on the hub.

claims.statement: The task list of a template being created shows 'Template' and the new template's name, such as 'Template Weekly Irish cattle'.
Documents are not part of a template: opening /upload-documents during a template journey redirects to the task list at /notification-hub.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:153-155 (step 'documents and declaration are not part of a template')

claims.statement: The declaration is not part of a template: opening /declaration during a template journey redirects to /review-notification.
The 'Review template' link on a new template's task list opens /review-notification, which shows the template's name.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:161-164 (step 'review the template and save it')
claims.quote:
await page.locator('main a', { hasText: 'Review template' }).click()
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/review-notification'))
      await expect(page.locator('main')).toContainText('Weekly Irish cattle')

claims.statement: A template can be saved from review with sections unanswered: the test answers only origin and commodity before saving.
claims.quote:
await answerOrigin(page, { search: 'Irel', country: 'Republic of Ireland' })
      await answerCommodity(page, SPECIES.cattle)
claims.note: Inferred: no other section is answered before the review form's submit saves the template.

claims.statement: Submitting the template review form saves the template and returns to /templates.
claims.note: The submit button's text on the template review page is not asserted.

claims.statement: After a new template is saved, the manage templates page shows a notification banner '<template name> saved to templates', such as 'Weekly Irish cattle saved to templates'.
claims.quote: await expect(page.locator('.govuk-notification-banner')).toContainText('Weekly Irish cattle saved to templates')

claims.statement: A saved new template joins the list: the count rises to 'Show 1-16 of 16 results'.
Opening /templates/create?new=1 directly starts a new template at the notification type question.
claims.note: Inferred: the test checks a notificationType radio right after going to the URL, so it lands on the type page as p8-052 shows.

claims.statement: The template name is optional: pressing 'Save and continue' with no name moves on to /origin-of-the-import with no error.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:174-179 (create a new template › a template with no name is saved as "Untitled template")
claims.quote:
await saveAndContinue(page)
    await submitForm(page, 'Save and continue')
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/origin-of-the-import'))

claims.statement: Opening /templates/save during a template journey saves the template and returns to /templates.
claims.note: No page link to /templates/save is asserted; the review form submit (p8-067) may post there.

claims.statement: A template saved with no name is called 'Untitled template', and the banner reads 'Untitled template saved to templates'.
No validation error is proven for the template name page: no test asserts a rule such as a maximum length or a duplicate name.
claims.note: Looked at every test that fills or skips the name field; none uses expectErrorSummary or expectInlineError.

claims.statement: During a template journey, /templates/discard shows a discard confirmation headed 'Delete this template?'.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:185-193 (create a new template › discard a template being created)
claims.quote:
await page.goto(url('/templates/discard'))
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/templates/discard'))
    await expectHeading(page, 'Delete this template?')
claims.note: No page link to /templates/discard is asserted; how a user reaches it is not shown.

claims.statement: The discard confirmation shows the name of the template being created, such as 'Name Throwaway'.
The discard confirmation's back link goes to /review-notification.
Pressing 'Yes, delete' on the discard confirmation discards the template being created and returns to /templates.
After a template being created is discarded, the manage templates page shows a banner '<template name> has been deleted', such as 'Throwaway has been deleted'.
Opening /templates/discard outside a template journey redirects to the manage templates page at /templates.
claims.ref: e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:202-205 (create a new template › the discard page outside a template journey returns to manage templates)

claims.statement: Only a live animals template is proven: every template test chooses the live-animals notification type, and no other type's template is exercised.
claims.note: Whether templates for germinal products or other types behave the same is not shown.

claims.statement: Only the first section's Change link (origin) is exercised; the template review mode of other sections' pages, and where their Save and return leads, is unproven.
